title: TC-TIB-028 — [Edge] Conditional settings of another layer sourced from inline GO items
steps:
Preconditions: Global Option (Additional Option, source = Create new) with 2+ items; another layer on the same artwork with Conditional settings

  1. On the other layer, open Conditional settings and set a condition based on this inline GO's selected item
  2. Check the item list offered in the conditional picker
  3. On storefront, select each item on the Additional Option field and verify the conditional layer reacts correctly
expectedResult: Conditional picker's item list matches the GO's inline items; selecting an item on storefront triggers the conditional layer exactly as configured.
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com, artwork #4572 ("QA TIB-5467 Additional Option inline test") on campaign 2730, product qa-tib-5467-additional-option-order-test on linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com. GO 986 (inline Additional Option, 54 items: Apple/Blue/Green/Zebra/Perf1-50) is layer-226664. A second layer-513136 (category-sourced GO 987, "QA TIB-5467 Category-sourced AO (TC-024)") was configured for this test to carry a Conditional Setting sourced from layer-226664/GO 986.

Setup performed for this case: opened layer-513136 in the artwork editor > Conditional Setting > Add conditions > target "Additional option" (only one other eligible layer, auto-resolves to layer-226664/GO 986) > is any of: Apple. Saved artwork, then clicked campaign "Update" and waited ~16s for propagation.

Observed (direct):

  • Conditional picker's "is any of" item dropdown listed exactly 54 options: Apple, Blue, Green, Zebra, Perf1...Perf50 — an exact match to GO 986's current inline item list (verified via DOM, not just visually).
  • On storefront (SDK cache-bypassed, localStorage cleared, fresh load): by default (no selection yet) only GO 986's own field (layer-226664) was present in the DOM; the conditional layer-513136 field was absent — consistent with "Show this layer on first load" being off and no condition met yet.
  • Selecting "Blue" on GO 986's field: layer-513136's field did NOT appear (condition correctly not met — Blue ≠ Apple).
  • Selecting "Apple" on GO 986's field (via real UI click, not programmatic DOM event): layer-513136's field (tee-field--layer-513136) appeared in the DOM, visible.
  • Switching back to "Blue": layer-513136's field disappeared again.

Conclusion: Conditional picker's item list exactly matches the inline GO's items, and selecting an item on storefront triggers the conditional layer exactly as configured (show on Apple, hide otherwise). No regression found.

Note: this is new test configuration added to artwork #4572 for this case (a Conditional Setting on layer-513136 targeting GO 986 = Apple) — left in place on staging per standing "no cleanup" instruction.
